What if one AI could run an entire video production studio? 🤯

Higgsfield posted a demo showing Claude Opus 5.5 controlling 12 laptops at once to create a launch video from a single prompt.

• 💻 Using Anthropic’s Computer Use alongside Higgsfield’s MCP integration, the model reportedly split tasks across multiple machines.

• 🎬 It generated visuals, built animations and returned an editable After Effects project.

• 🤖 The bigger shift is AI moving beyond generating content to actually operating software and coordinating workflows.

• ⚠️ Important: this is a vendor demo, not an independently verified result. No outside reviewer has confirmed the 12-laptop claim.

If systems like this become reliable, AI could move from being an editing assistant to coordinating entire creative workflows.

Would you trust AI to run your editing workflow, or just use it to speed up drafts? 👀
